ranked_data_influence.verdict: Price movement is the final arbiter for whether the prior thesis transmitted.
Fresh catalysts matter when source, freshness, and transmission mechanism are clear.

Dollar moves usually matter when the intraday change is large enough to transmit to gold.

low_or_no_weight_data.verdict: Useful macro context, but usually lower intraday weight unless the liquidity shift is large.

loopback_evaluation.scoring_feedback: Increase weight on the highest-ranked data types only when they aligned with the actual XAUUSD spot move; reduce weight on failed, stale, or non-transmitting inputs.

top_disruptive_events.historical_impact_basis: NFP surprises of this magnitude consistently produce sharp intraday gold moves via repriced Fed path; upside beats are reliably bearish for gold.

top_disruptive_events.title: US rate futures raise rate hike odds in December after jobs data
top_disruptive_events.claude_impact_reason: Confirms hawkish repricing—markets now seeing December HIKE odds rise after the strong jobs print. Direct Fed-path transmission lifting real yields and DXY, the dominant bearish driver for gold.
top_disruptive_events.historical_impact_basis: Shifts toward hike pricing (vs prior no-change expectation) sharply raise carry cost of gold and are among the most reliable bearish catalysts.

top_disruptive_events.title: Instant View: Strong May jobs number sends yields, rate expectations higher
top_disruptive_events.claude_impact_reason: Reinforces the post-NFP yield and rate-expectation surge. Confirms the bearish-gold transmission via rising real yields. Aggregated reaction piece, slightly lower marginal info than the print itself.
top_disruptive_events.historical_impact_basis: Yields and rate expectations rising together is the core carry-cost channel that pressures non-yielding gold intraday.
